work_orders.title: U3 suction/discharge valve job
work_orders.notes: Valve job complete, tech released. Unit isolated. Ready to return to service tomorrow.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Suspected gas leak at isolated U3 (post valve job WO-3317). U3 fuel valve indicates CLOSED (re-commanded closed at 19:00, feedback closed) but U3 fuel flow reads ~15 MSCFD steadily since ~18:01, and U3 enclosure gas detector rising linearly ~0.1%LEL/min (0.4% at 18:00, 6.6% at 19:02). Likely passing fuel valve or open fitting/vent left from maintenance. Please approach with portable gas monitor, verify leak source, manually isolate U3 fuel gas supply (upstream manual block) and check work site. U1/U2 running. Do NOT return U3 to service tonight.
